Live-fire sphere · WebGL 3D · procedural audio

HITSCAN

You stand inside a gridded sphere. Glass orbs appear at different depths; your pistol follows the cursor. Hit each orb before its ring closes. Harder levels pay more coins, which buy weapon finishes, sound packs and more in the Armory.

Level journey

Level 1 · Super Easy

First Steps

Extra modes · open after Level 1

Training level

Same orbs and scoring as the real level. Nothing is earned: no coins and no leaderboard.

Grid

The camera stays still and three orbs are always up. Hit one and the next appears on a free node at once.

Round length

Type any length from 10 to 150 seconds.

Scoring

  • +500Bullseye: hit the small circle in the middle of an orb
  • +250Streak bonus at 5 hits in a row, then +500 at 10, +750 at 15 and so on
  • −50A shot that hits nothing
  • −100An orb that explodes before you hit it
  • +1.5 sBullseye: hit the small circle in the middle of an orb
  • +0.8 sAny other hit
  • −1.0 sA shot that hits nothing
  • −2.5 sAn orb that explodes before you hit it
  • 3Orbs on the grid at all times
  • 0Penalties: orbs never explode and misses cost nothing
  • +500Bullseye bonus, and streak bonuses as usual
  • hit/sYour result: hits per second over the round

Range settings

Click to fire · R or right-click reloads · F inspects the pistol · L laser on/off · B Armory · C crosshair · Esc pauses · M mutes · 1–7 pick a level · 8 9 0 extra modes

Tap an orb to fire. Tap the magazine counter in the corner to reload early; it also reloads itself when empty. The laser sight switch is above, and the Armory and Crosshair buttons sit under your coins.

How do I turn on the global board?

The global top 500 runs on a small server that comes inside this file. Save it next to this game, run it with Node.js 22.13 or newer, then play at http://localhost:8787. Accounts made there work on every device that plays from it.

node hitscan-server.js
